_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in Disbelief coil with mixed factors and no clear breaker; 6% base rate of large moves makes HOLD the graded call.
next_move.brains_agree: Analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief; narrative silent on forward phase — agree only on lack of aggressive direction
next_move.confirmed_if: vix remains elevated and gold_strength continues to rise
next_move.invalidated_if: btc_momentum_30d surges and fear_greed rises sharply
